nom: Paula's Choice Skin Balancing Invisible Finish Moisture Gel

avis.titre: Smooths skin, great ingredients, pricy, Edit: inconsistent, sometimes fakeSmooths skin, great ingredients, pricy, Edit:
avis.texte: Amazing for normal/combo acne prone skin! I’ve been using this for a while now and I can’t stop. For the first week or two I started using it, it seeped into my skin super quickly! I’m assuming my skin really really needed the hydration. After that point I’ve been using less product because it doesn’t seep into my skin as quickly anymore. It smooths out my skin because of the niacinamide. One down part is that if you have sensitive skin it might tingle for a couple of minutes after using. After a while of using the product the little bit of burning I once felt starts to fade. (Update: been using this for over a month now and the tingling stopped!) Amazing product without any flaws! Edit: Disappointed! I reordered this product and I think this one came out to be fake. It doesn’t apply the same and it doesn’t look the same. I’m confused on if this is the real Paula’s choice one or if the other clear moisturizer was. I didn’t pay $29 for a fake!

I had been using Vanicream facial moisturizer, but while it did not break me out, it also was too heavy even though it can be used by all skin types it did not work for my oily skin. It (Vanicream) felt too heavy the following morning and made sunscreen application difficult. The PC gel works well and my skin does not feel damp even after cleansing and drying off. My nose is less red as it is less clogged and skin can breathe better if that makes sense. I use an almond sized amount for face and layer with Vanicream lotion to seal it in. Update: I have been on low dose accutane 20mg and differin (every 3rd nite) and I like using the PC gel to sandwich underneath differin and then layer Vanicream cream on top to seal it in. Face looks less dry and clogged and red.

I’m obsessed with this moisturizer! It’s so smooth, unscented, super soft, truly dries down with no shine, and feels very hydrating. I’ve used this every night since I bought it and sometimes in the morning (when I remember) and my skin has never felt better! Update 18 months later: I’m still obsessed y’all! I tried to use a less expensive gel moisturizer with similar properties (Good Molecules, sorry) and it simply pales in comparison. Paula’s leaves my skin feeling hydrated, calm, and NOT TIGHT. I have oily skin but it’s oily because it’s dehydrated on its own. This moisturizer addresses the dehydration without feeling heavy and calms/mattifies the oiliness. I cannot recommend this enough!

I have oily skin and it's been a struggle to find a moisturizer that isn't heavy and doesn't cause excess oil mid day, until I came across this product. It goes on so smoothly and feels like nothing is on my face. It leaves my face feeling smooth. I haven't notice any oil buildup by the end of day which is such a big deal for me. Definitely worth the money as it moisturizes and keeps oil at bay.

avis.titre: Too expensive for such a small bottle.
avis.texte: It is way smaller than I had anticipated. It is light-weight and very matte, but I don't really see too much difference compared to more affordable products from La Roche-Posay to be honest.

avis.titre: Lightweight, Effective, and Perfect for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using Paula’s Choice Invisible Finish Moisture Gel for a while now and it has quickly become one of my skincare staples. I love how lightweight and hydrating it feels on my skin — it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or sticky residue. It’s perfect under makeup or on its own, and it keeps my skin soft, smooth, and balanced throughout the day. It’s especially great for anyone with sensitive or combination skin. I haven’t experienced any breakouts or irritation since using it.The only downside is that it’s a little on the pricey side, but honestly, the quality and how well it works makes it worth the splurge. I’ll definitely keep this in my skincare routine.
I can’t thank enough. This is the only moisture which works for my skin.
Great for oily skin and the small tube goes a long ways. I love Paula products. It makes your skin feel smooth and soft. A great value for money.
Great product to have as moisturizer feels v light on skin also shine free but while in hot weather gets little bit shiny on t zone

The texture and feel of the cream is amazing worth the price and Paula’s choice never disappointed me so far ! Face cleanser, toner sunscreen everything worked so great so far! fyi I have oily combo skin

What can I say? Is not for me, I don't like a face cream to have sillicone in it, I can't stand it on my skin. Feels horrible 😥 Is my fault I did not read the ingredients first, now I'm stuck with it... I think I'm gona bin it.

This is my HG moisturizer. I have complicated sensitive/oily/breakout-prone skin, and have tried all sorts of products from high-end brands like Elizabeth Arden and Clinique, to more affordable ones like Cerave. I apply this day and night to damp skin after cleansing, massage it lightly until it's fully absorbed, and follow it up with organic jojoba oil. My skin feels so supple and baby soft afterwards! I honestly love Paula's Choice products, and will continue to re-purchase. I also order it in bulk, as I'm scared to ever run out of this gem! The tube looks small, but one has personally lasted me 4 months (as mentioned, I apply on damp skin, so it helps on the spreadability, and you really just need a small amount, about the size of your pinky nail). Please don't ever discontinue this product, as I don't know how to even begin to find a replacement for it after such a long and painful search!
